commentary.text: 90+5' Alberto Arena is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' A pass by Nico Paz (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+1' An attempted cross from Lennon Miller (Udinese) is cleared.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Nico Paz (Como) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
89' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefan Posch (Como) replacing Mergim Vojvoda.
89' Substitution. Ivan Smolcic (Como) has come on for Ignace Van der Brempt.
88' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
86' Alberto Arena shows the yellow card to Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) for a heavy challenge.
86' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
85' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
83' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
81' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) attempts to find Nicolo Bertola, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
80' Alessandro Zanoli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
79' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Alex Valle (Como) replaces Alberto Moreno.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) for Jesus Rodriguez.
76' The linesman raises his flag. Keinan Davis (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
75' Here is a change. Christian Kabasele is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Oumar Solet (Udinese).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Jakub Piotrowski cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
70' Alberto Arena shows a yellow card to Christian Kabasele (Udinese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
68' Substitution. Maxence Caqueret makes way for Nico Paz (Como).
67' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) has received a yellow card for his foul.
65' The game is interrupted. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

63' Maxence Caqueret (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alberto Arena with no other option than to blow for a foul.
60' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!
60' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
59' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Maximo Perrone (Como).
58' Maxence Caqueret (Como) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
57' The goal by Udinese won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
57' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Udinese players aren’t happy.
56' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is released by Lennon Miller, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
55' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
54' Flag goes up against Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
51' The ball is cleared after Jesus Rodriguez (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

48' What a chance that is! Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
47' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
46' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. It will be a corner kick for Udinese.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Kosta Runjaic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Hassane Kamara (Udinese). He is replaced by Lennon Miller.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Alberto Arena blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' What a sweet touch by Maximo Perrone (Como) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Daniele Padelli to hold.
45+2' Maxence Caqueret (Como) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Daniele Padelli.
41' A cross from Maximo Perrone (Como) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
39' Keinan Davis (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Udinese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jesus Rodriguez (Como), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
37' Maximo Perrone (Como) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mergim Vojvoda (Como).
35' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

33' Alberto Moreno (Como) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
33' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
32' The foul by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alberto Arena.
31' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' A pass from Maxence Caqueret (Como) is intercepted by Daniele Padelli and the move breaks down.

28' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
26' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
25' A pass by Mergim Vojvoda (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
24' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
24' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

23' Maxence Caqueret (Como) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Como.
22' Maximo Perrone (Como) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
21' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' The foul by Maximo Perrone (Como) was seen by Alberto Arena who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
18' 1 - 0 GOAL! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Daniele Padelli in goal.
18' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
17' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. That's a penalty to Como! They have a good chance to score now.
17' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
16' A pass by Jesus Rodriguez (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

13' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
10' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Hassane Kamara (Udinese) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
7' Maxence Caqueret (Como) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
5' Jacobo Ramon (Como) was too forceful with his tackle and Alberto Arena interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) tries to find Lucas Da Cunha, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alberto Arena.
